baseline_models.focus_anchor: The passive intensive بُرِّزَتِ, the noun ٱلْجَحِيمُ, and the open-ended لِمَن يَرَىٰ.
baseline_models.mechanism: A concealed, fiercely burning reality is made to stand openly within a viewer's perceptual field.

activation_trace.role: Appearance after concealment supplies the decisive transition into visibility.
Blazing fire and intense heat identify what is made manifest.
Vision by eye or insight supplies the receiving witness.

changed_reading.before: Hell is simply said to be visible.
changed_reading.after: Hell is deliberately brought out of concealment as an unavoidable public object of sight.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: بُرِّزَتِ marks disclosure and يَرَىٰ can include inward judgment as well as eyesight.
baseline_models.mechanism: Manifestation converts a reported or conceived danger into direct perceptual and cognitive certainty.

activation_trace.role: Uncovering supplies the move from hidden claim to present evidence.
Judgment and reflection let seeing function as recognition, not bare optics.
The intense blaze gives recognition a concrete and threatening content.

changed_reading.after: The disclosure forces the viewer to know as witnessed fact what could previously remain an idea.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The مبارزة branch of ب ر ز, the battle branch of ج ح م, and the mutual-facing branch of ر ء ي.
baseline_models.mechanism: The displayed fire can be imagined as an adversarial presence brought forward so that viewer and threat face one another.

activation_trace.role: Stepping out singly for combat turns presentation into confrontation.
The heat of battle and death gives the confrontation mortal force.
Mutual facing supplies the spatial relation between witness and displayed threat.

changed_reading.before: Hell is an exhibit placed before spectators.
changed_reading.after: Hell is brought forward as an opponent whom the viewer must face.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier sequence of pounding hearts and lowered eyes revises يَرَىٰ from neutral observation into vision registered through fear, posture, and loss of composure.

activation_trace.role: Eye or insight remains the focus act whose bodily quality is revised.
The fierce blaze supplies the object capable of provoking the response.
The heart supplies the inward seat in which the encounter is first registered.
Agitation and heartbeat give that inward registration a violent rhythm.
Physical eyesight links the earlier eyes directly to the focus act of seeing.
Lowering and submission make vision itself an enacted abasement.

structural_cues: 79:8 moves from quaking hearts to 79:9 humbled sights before 79:36 names the act of seeing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inward agitation followed by lowered eyesight; I infer that the disclosed blaze causes or crystallizes this embodied abasement, while the live alternative is that these are parallel resurrection snapshots rather than a causal chain.

changed_reading.before: The viewer calmly registers a disclosed object.
changed_reading.after: Seeing the disclosed blaze is a whole-body event in which heart and gaze collapse into submission.

context_deltas.mechanism: A visible sign can still be denied, while lesson and warning are repeatedly received by one who fears; therefore يَرَىٰ can mark responsive apprehension rather than optical exposure alone.

activation_trace.role: Manifestation supplies something objectively available to perception.
Reflection and judgment supply the deeper uptake that bare exposure cannot guarantee.
Awe shading into knowledge links fear with cognitively effective reception.
A manifest sign supplies a prior instance of evidence being shown.
Contradicting truth shows that visibility and acknowledgment can separate.
Taking one condition as a lesson for another supplies interpretive passage beyond looking.
Warning that awakens caution supplies the practical effect of genuine seeing.

structural_cues: The audience formulas لِمَن يَخْشَىٰ (79:26), لِمَن يَرَىٰ (79:36), and مَن يَخْشَىٰهَا (79:45) frame different modes of reception.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a shown sign followed by denial and repeatedly pairs lesson or warning with fear; I infer a distinction between being exposed to evidence and truly seeing it, while the alternative is that the three audience formulas identify occasions without defining one another.

changed_reading.before: Anyone with functioning eyes sees hell once it is displayed.
changed_reading.after: The verse also tests whether exposure becomes recognition: the true seer apprehends the disclosed reality as warning and lesson.

context_deltas.mechanism: Pharaoh gathers an audience, proclaims his own elevation, and is seized as a deterrent example; this strengthens the focus branches of emergence for combat and mutual facing as a public reversal of self-display.

activation_trace.role: Emergence for single combat supplies the focus scene's confrontational staging.
Battle and death make the staged confrontation consequential.
Mutual facing gives the counterstage an audience and an opponent.
The raised public call supplies deliberate self-presentation.
Driving a group to one destination supplies the assembled audience.
Arrogant self-exaltation supplies what the later display reverses.
Being taken to account converts proclamation into adjudication.
Punishment that deters others makes the reversal publicly exemplary.

structural_cues: 79:23-25 runs from gathering and proclamation through a highest claim to seizure and exemplary punishment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a ruler's public self-elevation and public reversal; I infer that hell's being brought forward generalizes this into a counter-display that confronts every claim, while the live alternative is that the Moses episode warns without furnishing the focus scene's staging.

changed_reading.before: Hell is displayed before passive spectators.
changed_reading.after: Hell is brought onto a public counterstage where self-exalting claims meet their adversarial answer.

context_deltas.mechanism: The coordinated darkening of night and extraction of bright morning supplies a cosmic concealment-to-disclosure template; the blazing object of 79:36 becomes a terrible counterpart to dawn.

activation_trace.role: Uncovering after concealment supplies the focus half of the cosmic analogy.
Blazing heat turns the disclosed object into a dreadful light-source.
Vision registers the result of the transition into light.
Making night dark supplies the concealment pole of the sequence.
Bringing something out of hiding supplies a close functional analogue to بُرِّزَتِ.
Morning brightness and clarity supply the visible result of cosmic extraction.

structural_cues: 79:29 coordinates darkening the night with bringing out its daylight; 79:36 again foregrounds a making-manifest.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an explicit darkness-to-daylight operation and the focus supplies fire made visible; I infer a counter-dawn analogy in which judgment is illuminated, while the alternative is that 79:29 remains only evidence of creative power.

changed_reading.before: Hell is moved into an already visible scene.
changed_reading.after: Hell's disclosure is itself a catastrophic dawn: concealment ends because the blazing reality now lights the field of judgment.

context_deltas.mechanism: Remembered striving immediately precedes exposed hell, pairing inward retrieval of conduct with outward manifestation of consequence.

activation_trace.role: External uncovering supplies the visible half of the paired disclosure.
The blaze gives remembered conduct an immediately present consequence.
Recognition lets the viewer connect the manifested consequence to remembered action.
Work and acquired conduct supply the personal record whose consequence is exposed.
Retrieval after forgetfulness supplies an inward unveiling immediately before the outward one.

structural_cues: 79:35 and 79:36 are adjacent in one crisis sequence: remembered striving, then exposed hell.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies remembered work immediately before external exposure; I infer a single forensic disclosure linking record and result, while the alternative is that memory and sight are consecutive but independent events.

changed_reading.before: The viewer sees an external punishment.
changed_reading.after: The viewer sees a verdict whose fit has already been disclosed internally through recovered memory of personal striving.

context_deltas.mechanism: The two following cases connect exceeded limits and chosen desire to one refuge, and restraint to another; the focus display therefore reveals a destination formed by prior orientation, not an isolated spectacle.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure supplies the moment when a trajectory's destination becomes manifest.
The focus blaze is the destination named again in the first following case.
Recognition turns destination into an understood consequence of orientation.
Crossing the limit supplies the first trajectory toward the displayed outcome.
Choosing one thing over another makes that trajectory an enacted preference.
Joining a shelter turns the seen blaze into an attained abode.
Restraint supplies the contrary trajectory in the second case.
The soul's inclination names the force either preferred or restrained.
The sheltered garden supplies the opposed destination.

structural_cues: 79:37-41 immediately parses two فَأَمَّا مَن cases and answers each with an emphatic refuge clause.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed choices and opposed refuges immediately after the focus; I infer that disclosure reveals where prior orientation has been leading, while the alternative is that all people see the same display and only the later clauses assign destinations.

changed_reading.before: Hell is an object shown to an otherwise unspecified viewer.
changed_reading.after: The display becomes diagnostic recognition of an endpoint: chosen transgression resolves into the blaze as refuge, contrasted with the garden reached through restraint.

context_deltas.mechanism: At the closing recurrence of seeing, prolonged earthly duration contracts to an evening or morning; the focus act of sight therefore marks a temporal re-scaling as well as spatial disclosure.

activation_trace.role: Manifest presence supplies the threshold at which prior duration is reassessed.
Seeing supplies the focus event repeated by the closing temporal comparison.
A span of time supplies the duration that is retrospectively rescaled.
The morning interval supplies one short bound for remembered duration.
Remaining in a place supplies the elapsed stay that appears compressed.
The evening interval supplies the other short bound for remembered duration.

structural_cues: 79:46 reuses seeing at the surah's close and measures the prior stay as only an evening or its morning.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a temporal estimate explicitly attached to the closing act of seeing; I infer that the focus disclosure initiates this re-scaling of lived time, while the alternative is that 79:46 concerns sight of the Hour generally rather than the exposed blaze specifically.

changed_reading.before: The disclosure changes what occupies the viewer's visual field.
changed_reading.after: The disclosure also changes the viewer's scale of time: once the reality is seen, the formerly dominant life-span contracts to a brief interval.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because grammar assigns seeing to the human, not to hell; it remains anchored in the packet's glaring-eye branch of ج ح م, mutual-facing branch of ر ء ي, and immediately preceding pupil-image branch of الإنسان. Render it only as a personifying visual activation, never as a claim that the verse literally says hell sees.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The eye-like branch of ٱلْجَحِيمُ and the facing relation latent in يَرَىٰ let the displayed object momentarily resemble a gaze returned.

activation_trace.role: Uncovering places the personified presence openly before the viewer.
The glaring or inflamed eye supplies a personifying shape for the blaze.
Mutual facing lets ordinary looking flicker into a meeting of gazes.
The human image in the pupil makes the adjacent viewer visually implicated in what is faced.

changed_reading.before: A human subject looks at a passive fire.
changed_reading.after: The scene can momentarily read as reciprocal exposure: the glaring blaze faces the human whose own image sits in the eye.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant ر و ي mapping for the written root ر ء ي; it remains worth carrying because the surah explicitly introduces a حديث and culminates in visual manifestation. Render it as sound-linked, lexicographic wordplay about mediation, not as the morphology or primary sense of يَرَىٰ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The dominant visual branch of يَرَىٰ and its packet-supplied non-dominant narration branch meet the disclosure verb بُرِّزَتِ.

activation_trace.role: Manifestation supplies the transition from mediated account to present object.
Direct vision supplies the endpoint of that transition.
Narrating report or verse supplies the exploratory mediated starting point.
News renewed as a narrated account supplies the surah's explicit report frame.

changed_reading.before: The warning remains something narrated about a future scene.
changed_reading.after: At بُرِّزَتِ لِمَن يَرَىٰ, transmitted report gives way to immediate witness: what was heard is now made seen.

strongest_changes: Seeing became embodied and ethically responsive rather than neutral optical access.
The adjacency of remembered striving and exposed hell made the disclosure function as a personally intelligible verdict.
The night-to-morning extraction cast the blazing manifestation as a catastrophic counter-dawn.
The opposed refuges and the closing temporal contraction turned the display into both destination-recognition and re-scaling of earthly time.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah package allowed humbled sight, shown-yet-denied evidence, Pharaoh's public reversal, cosmic disclosure, remembered action, opposed refuges, and the final recurrence of seeing to remain distinct mechanisms around one compact focus ayah.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether لِمَن يَرَىٰ merely names universal visual access or also foregrounds the ethically responsive seer.
Whether the public counterstage and counter-dawn are deliberate rhetorical mechanisms or only productive analogies.
How much interpretive weight the eye, pupil, and non-dominant narration branches can bear beyond explicitly exploratory wordplay.
